guidance.said: Infosys expects FY27 constant currency revenue growth to be between 1.5% and 3.5% year-on-year.
guidance.quote: Our revenue growth guidance for the financial year 2027 is 1.5% to 3.5% growth year-on-year in constant currency terms.
guidance.speaker: Salil Parekh

guidance.said: Operating margin guidance for financial year 2027 is 20% to 22%.
guidance.quote: Our operating margin guidance for financial year '27 is 20% to 22%.
guidance.speaker: Salil Parekh

guidance.said: Infosys expects to hire at least 20,000 freshers in FY27.
guidance.quote: This year also, we are expecting at least 20,000 freshers to be hired.
guidance.speaker: Jayesh Sanghrajka

guidance.said: Effective tax rate for FY27 is expected to be in the range of 29% to 30%.
guidance.quote: We expect effective tax rates for the FY27 to be in the range of 29% to 30%.
guidance.speaker: Jayesh Sanghrajka

reported.quote: On Q4, our growth year-on-year was 4.1% in constant currency terms.
We had growth of 3.1% for the full year in constant currency terms.
Large deals were very good, $14.9 bn for the full year, $3.2 bn for the fourth quarter.
Q4 operating margins stood at 20.9%, down 0.3% sequentially, adjusted for the Labor Code impact in Q3.
Headcount at the end of the year was over 328,000.
FY26 revenues crossed $20 bn and grew 3.1% in constant currency terms, within the upgraded guidance band given in January.

business: Infosys delivers IT, cloud, and artificial intelligence services across domains including data, engineering, legacy modernization, physical AI, and process transformation. Its key industry operating segments include Financial Services, Manufacturing, Communications, Retail, Energy, Utilities, Resources & Services, and Life Sciences.
